vis.scope: Scalar MS path; FIELD grammar and ANTENNA metadata resolve against the MS, and successful calls append HISTORY.

caltable.scope: G/T Jones complex, single-channel gains; flagged samples and unequal intervals, undefined/type errors and duplicate timestamps. Sorted read-only big-endian inputs and rows published beyond stale table.dat counts retain complete products.

fluxtable.scope: Full gains or incremental corrections with all scientific columns, owning subtables and atomic publication.

reference.scope: Scalar/vector FIELD grammar, numeric IDs, names, regex and quoted punctuation; equal reference-field means and missing solutions.

transfer.scope: Scalar/vector FIELD grammar; empty selects non-reference solved fields; unselected fields remain in full products.

listfile.scope: Fluxes, errors, counts and fitted spectra written to the requested text file; overlapping scientific input/output paths are refused.

append.scope: Creates a new table or appends sorted full/incremental products, preserves metadata, and supports cross-engine append.

refspwmap.scope: Singleton broadcast, per-window mapping, negative sentinel and Python bool-to-int coercion; empty vector safely means identity.

gainthreshold.scope: Disabled negative/default threshold, Float32 median boundaries and CASA antenna/time/scan threshold-population semantics.

antenna.scope: Names, IDs, ranges, baseline expressions and partial !antenna restrictions combined with time/scan.

timerange.scope: Shared CASA time grammar including partial dates and ranges, evaluated against the selected logical rows.

scan.scope: Numeric ranges, unions and comparisons, including partial antenna/time combinations.

incremental.scope: One correction per field/window/antenna with CASA time/grid, metadata, reference identity and PARAMERR/SNR conventions.

fitorder.scope: Constant, linear and higher determined polynomial fits with covariance and errors; negative fallback, bounded degree and padded results.

display.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14 plotting hooks are empty; True is verified to produce the same scientific output without a plot.

behaviors.title: Transfer flux and uncertainties
behaviors.scope: Unit time weights, per-antenna/polarization means, equal reference-field weighting, median ratios, CASA flux error and solution count.
behaviors.gap: The original 4.8% discrepancy is corrected. CASA and native return 1.014581621096799 Jy, 0.03767496546937333 Jy error and 10 solutions.

behaviors.title: Selections and reference populations
behaviors.scope: Reference/transfer FIELD grammar and antenna/time/scan combinations change estimation while preserving unselected full-product rows.
behaviors.gap: Fourteen captured same-input selector fixtures and the public-Python oracle cover the independent source-derived populations.

behaviors.title: Products, public Python state and exchange
behaviors.scope: All 15 names/order/defaults, positional/keyword calls, return/error policy, full/incremental/append tables, listing and successful/failed MS HISTORY.
behaviors.gap: CASA reads native products and both engines append each other's products. Native computation does not require CASA.

behaviors.title: Multi-window spectral fits
behaviors.scope: Fitted reference frequency, flux/errors, coefficient/errors and covariance for orders 0 through 4, retaining stricter existing linear tests.
behaviors.gap: CASA crashes and underdetermined/zero-degree-of-freedom defects are corrected under the standing CASA-bug policy.

decisions.record: Fluxscale negative and underdetermined spectral-fit orders
decisions.inputs: Negative order, too few valid windows for requested degree, or an exactly determined fit.
decisions.casa: Can segfault, fit the wrong degree, return unstable coefficients/negative covariance, or invent roundoff uncertainty.
decisions.ours: Use advertised negative-order fallback; cap degree at nvalid-1, pad requested vectors and retain zero residual uncertainty at zero residual degrees of freedom.
decisions.rationale: Implement identifiable fits and CASA's advertised fallback while retaining existing strict linear-fit behavior.
decisions.impact: Determined fits agree; invalid memory access and unstable underdetermined artifacts are corrected.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing owner rule in AGENTS.md: correct CASA crashes, out-of-bounds writes, corrupt data or behavior contradicting evident intent.

decisions.record: Fluxscale history can contain uninitialized object identifiers
decisions.inputs: Successful MS HISTORY writes or refspwmap=[].
decisions.casa: Does not initialize OBJECT_ID; indexes an empty map and segfaults.
decisions.ours: Initialize OBJECT_ID=0 and treat the empty map as identity.
decisions.rationale: Avoid uninitialized scientific provenance and invalid memory access.
decisions.impact: Stable provenance; empty mapping is safe.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing owner rule in AGENTS.md: correct CASA crashes, out-of-bounds writes, corrupt data or behavior contradicting evident intent.

decisions.record: Fluxscale listfile can overwrite scientific table files
decisions.inputs: A listing path inside the input MS, input caltable or output product, or a failed listing stream.
decisions.casa: Can truncate a scientific table file or report success despite an unchecked stream failure.
decisions.ours: Refuse overlapping paths before mutation and report listing write failures.
decisions.rationale: Preserve scientific data and fulfill the requested text output.
decisions.impact: Potentially destructive paths are refused; ordinary listing paths work.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing owner rule in AGENTS.md: correct CASA crashes, out-of-bounds writes, corrupt data or behavior contradicting evident intent.

oracle.kind: Scientific, Python API/state and interchange comparison
oracle.scope: 70 same-argument public-Python cases on the same CASA-made G/T gains, plus 3 documented spectral-order corrections checked against identifiable CASA fits; captured original/selector fixtures, read-only big-endian inputs, published rows beyond stale control counts, and independent C++ readback.
oracle.result: 73 cases passed, zero comparison failures; all 15 owned parameters have implemented behavior.

performance.scope: Five alternating public-Python/CASA full/incremental runs, warm/cold, 60k and 300k equal-product inputs, fixed HISTORY; phases, user/system CPU, throughput, memory and fresh imports. Controlled native before/after and raw data-I/O reference separately attributed.
performance.result: 60k full native 0.099–0.120 s versus CASA 5.190–5.616 s; 300k 0.539–0.603 s versus 27.113–27.436 s (45–50×), ~122 MB RSS. CPU/wall remains ~1.00 warm and 0.95–0.97 cold. The owner explicitly approved this measured fluxscale-specific CPU-performance exception on 2026-11-17; #990 is complete. This is not an I/O-limited measurement claim or an exception for other calibration tasks.
performance.owner_decision: 2026-11-17, owner in conversation: “Approve the measured fluxscale performance exception.” Scope: residual CPU use at the recorded fluxscale measurements; no scientific/API or programme-wide waiver.
